title: Contaminated drinking water in Kanke
description: Drinking water supplied through municipal taps in Kanke Ranchi has a foul smell and yellow discoloration. Multiple residents have diarrhea and waterborne illnesses. Water purification plant needs immediate overhaul.

title: Garbage accumulation near Sakchi market
description: Waste is piling up near Sakchi vegetable market in Jamshedpur for over a week without any municipal truck collection. Stray animals are scattering trash and breeding flies.

title: Drainage overflow in Doranda
description: Open drainage in Doranda Ranchi is completely choked with plastic and silt causing sewage water to flood streets and enter residential homes during heavy rains.

title: Broken water pipeline in Dhanbad
description: Underground water supply pipeline burst near Bank More Dhanbad causing millions of liters of potable water to flood the road while residential taps are completely dry.

title: Arsenic and fluoride in rural wells
description: Groundwater in several handpumps across rural Gumla district contains toxic levels of fluoride causing dental and skeletal fluorosis among school children.

title: Potholes on Birsa Munda Airport road
description: The arterial road connecting Birsa Munda Airport to central Ranchi has crater-sized potholes leading to severe accidents and damaged vehicles especially at night.

title: Collapsing bridge in Bokaro
description: Old concrete bridge across river near Bokaro Steel City has visible structural cracks and exposed iron rebars posing grave collapse risk during monsoon flash floods.

title: Unpaved dirt road in Khunti village
description: Primary access road connecting 4 tribal villages to Khunti market remains unpaved mud track completely impassable for ambulances and delivery vehicles.

title: Street pavement cave-in in Bistupur
description: Main pedestrian footpath in Bistupur commercial hub collapsed into storm drain creating dangerous exposed trench without any warning barricades.

title: Damaged highway divider in Hazaribagh
description: National Highway divider on NH-33 stretch in Hazaribagh broken with loose concrete blocks lying scattered across high-speed lanes.

title: No primary health center in Namkum
description: Namkum block has no functional primary health clinic within 15 km distance forcing tribal patients and expectant mothers to travel hours for basic emergency care.

title: Shortage of essential medicines at RIMS
description: Ranchi Institute of Medical Sciences emergency ward lacks basic antibiotic injections, IV fluids, and pediatric syrups forcing poor patients to buy from private stores.

title: Non-functional ambulance in Latehar
description: The solitary government ambulance assigned to Latehar rural sub-division has been broken down for two months leaving remote pregnant women stranded.

title: Dengue outbreak in Jamshedpur slums
description: Sudden surge in confirmed dengue and malaria cases across Kadma and Sonari slum clusters with zero municipal fogging or larvicide spraying conducted.

title: Lack of doctors in Gumla district hospital
description: Gumla district hospital has sanctioned 12 specialist doctors but only 2 general practitioners are attending outpatient departments serving 500 patients daily.

title: Collapsed school roof in Jharia
description: Government primary school roof in Jharia coal belt partially collapsed during rains forcing 120 young students to sit under trees for daily classes.

title: No electricity or fans in rural school
description: Primary school in Torpa Khunti has had disconnected power lines for 6 months resulting in suffocating classrooms with temperature reaching 42 degrees.

title: Lack of science laboratory in college
description: Government Degree College in Chaibasa offers B.Sc courses without functional chemistry and physics lab equipment or chemical reagents.

title: Drinking water shortage in girls school
description: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya in Dumka lacks dedicated running water and sanitary facilities causing high dropout rates among adolescent girls.

title: Shortage of teachers in remote schools
description: Three tribal middle schools in Simdega district are operating with only one contractual teacher managing classes 1 through 8 simultaneously.

title: Industrial effluents in Subarnarekha river
description: Multiple chemical and manufacturing units in Adityapur Industrial Area discharge toxic untreated red wastewater directly into Subarnarekha river.

title: Severe air pollution near Dhanbad coal mines
description: Coal dust from open-cast mines and unpaved haulage tracks in Dhanbad creates dense toxic smog triggering widespread respiratory illnesses and asthma.

title: Illegal timber logging in Saranda forest
description: Large scale deforestation and illegal felling of Sal trees observed deep inside Saranda forest reserve without forest ranger intervention.

title: Toxic burning of e-waste in Ranchi outskirts
description: Informal scrap dealers regularly set fire to plastic wires and electronic waste on Ranchi ring road emitting thick carcinogenic black smoke.

title: Plastic waste choking Dalma sanctuary streams
description: Unregulated tourist dumping of plastic bottles, bags, and food wrappers is contaminating natural freshwater streams inside Dalma Wildlife Sanctuary.

title: No street lights on Dimna Road
description: Dimna link road connecting Mango to NH-33 has 40 non-functioning street light poles turning a 3 km stretch pitch dark and accident-prone every night.

title: Frequent voltage fluctuations in Kanke
description: Unstable electricity supply with violent voltage surges is burning household appliances and pump motors across residential colonies in Kanke Ranchi.

title: Low hanging high tension power cables
description: High tension 11kV electrical wire sagging dangerously just 7 feet above pedestrian pathway near rural school playground in Ramgarh.

title: Repeated power cuts in Deoghar during festival
description: Deoghar temple town experiences 10 to 14 hours of unscheduled daily power outages causing immense distress to pilgrims and small businesses.

title: Damaged electricity transformer in rural village
description: Main village electrical transformer exploded 3 weeks ago in Ormanjhi block leaving 80 farming households in total darkness without power.

title: Irregular bus connectivity to Bokaro
description: Public bus service between Ranchi capital and Bokaro Steel City has become highly erratic with over half of scheduled buses cancelled without notice.

title: Lack of auto rickshaw regulation at railway station
description: Unregulated private auto drivers at Ranchi junction railway station overcharge passengers fivefold and engage in aggressive harassment.

title: Unsafe school vans operating without permits
description: Old overloaded commercial vans carrying 25 kindergarten children without seatbelts or speed governors operating daily across Jamshedpur roads.

title: Absence of bus stop shelter in monsoon
description: Daily commuters including elderly waiting for state transport buses at Birsa Chowk have no rain shelter or sitting benches exposed to storms.

title: Frequent train delays on Ranchi Howrah route
description: Local passenger trains on Ranchi to Howrah rail corridor experience chronic 4-hour delays severely disrupting students and office commuters.

title: Drought and lack of canal irrigation in Gumla
description: Farmers in Gumla district have suffered total paddy crop failure due to dry irrigation canals and lack of diesel subsidies for borewell water.

title: Fall armyworm pest infestation in maize
description: Aggressive pest attack by fall armyworm destroying hundreds of acres of standing maize crops across Palamu district without subsidized pesticides.

title: Lack of cold storage for tomato farmers
description: Tomato growers in Ormanjhi Ranchi are forced into distress sales at 2 rupees per kg due to total absence of solar-powered local cold storage units.

title: Spurious seeds supplied to tribal farmers
description: Substandard hybrid paddy seeds distributed by local cooperative society failed to germinate causing financial ruin to 150 smallholder families.

title: Soil erosion washing away fertile farmland
description: Flash rains and lack of contour check dams causing massive topsoil erosion across agricultural terraced fields in Simdega hills.

title: Spike in chain snatching incidents near Ranchi station
description: Gang of motorcycle riders targeting women pedestrians in evening hours around Ranchi Station and Overbridge with inactive police CCTV.

title: Illegal sand mining mafias operating on Damodar river
description: Heavily armed syndicates extracting illegal riverbed sand using mechanized excavators during midnight hours threatening riverbank stability.

title: Lack of police patrolling in university area
description: Complete absence of women police personnel and street patrols around Ranchi University Morabadi campus after dark leading to harassment.

title: Open abandoned mining pits without fencing
description: Unfenced deep open-cast coal mining water pits in Ramgarh have claimed lives of 3 children who accidentally slipped while grazing cattle.

title: Drunk driving accidents on Ring Road
description: Late night speeding trucks and drunk drivers on Ranchi Outer Ring Road cause fatal collisions weekly without any breathalyzer checkpoints.
